name: ed25519_keygen
title: A random 32-byte seed becomes an Ed25519 key through the Rust openssl crate.

origin.description: A random 32-byte seed becomes an Ed25519 key through the Rust openssl crate.
origin.details: A fresh Ed25519 key signs hello and the signature verifies. The key itself is not compared.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.
origin.example: key <- ed25519_keygen(); ed25519_verify(charToRaw("hello"), ed25519_sign(charToRaw("hello"), key), key$pubkey)
